title: Settings member admission plan sends a generic Scrape auth field rejected by hosted preflight
preconditions: Use the reviewed normal Settings member admission route on synchronized clean main with a successful exact-source CI artifact.
Stage a fresh authorized one-use member link and select lane A/macOS Intel.
reproduction: The Settings plan inherits scrape_auth_mode=member from the member-Data plan.
The actual Require exactly one artifact provenance mode workflow shell reaches its generic non-Scrape/non-Notes/non-Data branch and exits 1 because SCRAPE_AUTH_MODE is member.
expected: The plan passes generic workflow provenance preflight while settings-account-popover-member still requires and uses the designated nonadmin member credential.
actual: Run 38211228069 passed the guarded macos-15-intel member Settings route on exact-source development artifact 11728859637; generic Scrape auth was guest while the acceptance case authenticated as an ordinary member. The independent peer accepted T20/T23/T26 only. This retests the admission regression; it does not establish broader Settings acceptance.
cause: Planner reuse carried a Data-specific generic Scrape field into a Settings route. CLI tests doubled GitHub dispatch and did not execute the production provenance shell.
severity: S2: guarded member Settings acceptance cannot start
priority: P1: resolved for the guarded member Settings admission route
source_fix: The Settings-only plan maps inherited scrape_auth_mode=member to guest. Member authentication remains determined by acceptance_case; workflow and resource policies are unchanged.
verification_status: Retested by a successful hosted run using generic Scrape auth guest and the actual Settings member acceptance case. Independent reviewer accepted the limited native T20/T23/T26 results. The strict-verifier receipt was not independently replayed; startup-only screenshots and receipt-level cleanup do not broaden this retest. No claim is made for neighboring cases or full Settings.
next_action: No further action for this admission regression. Member Settings coverage remains bounded to T20/T23/T26; all other cases and roles remain separately tracked.
